Name: Purchasable Clay
Author: Hikari014
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=6][b]OBSOLETE. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23811]Try this instead[/url]. The mod page is still visible just for archival purposes and for those who are still in 1.5.6.[/b][/size][/color]

[center][color=#ff7700][size=5][b]A very simple mod, it adds the clay into Robin's shop as a purchasable item.[/b][/size][/color]

Basically, this is just my personal mod, but it wouldn't hurt to share it here. Who knows, maybe there is someone who having this problem as well.

It begins when I start a new save with the new beach farm layout which is relying heavily on the use of Retaining Soil fertilizers. And to craft them, we need clay (at least the quality version though). I'm getting tired of tilling soil here and there and the ready-to-use fertilizer is very expensive. So here I am.

########
[color=#00ffff][size=4]Installation[/size][/color]
########[/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't done that before.
[*]﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url] because this is a content pack for it.
[*]Download and unzip this mod to[font=Courier New] Stardew Valley/Mods [/font]and you're done.
[/list]

[center]########
[size=4][color=#00ffff]Configuration[/color][/size]
########
[size=2]These are just a few basic configs, for a complete and detailed documentation, see [url=https://github.com/ChroniclerCherry/stardew-valley-mods/blob/master/ShopTileFramework/README.md]Shop Tile Framework readme[/url].[/size][/center][size=2]
[size=3]In the[font=Courier New] [/font][/size][font=Courier New]shops.json [/font][size=3]file :[/size][/size]

[list]
[*][b][code]﻿"ShopName": "RobinShop"[/code][/b]
This is the target shop, you can change[font=Courier New] RobinShop [/font]into any shop you want, you can see the valid value [url=https://github.com/ChroniclerCherry/stardew-valley-mods/blob/master/ShopTileFramework/README.md#vanilla-shops]here[/url]. [*][b][code]﻿"AddStockAboveVanilla": "true"[/code][/b]
If true, automatically add clay to the very first order in the shop menu list. [*][b][code]﻿"StockPrice": "30"[/code][/b]
Specify the (buy) price,[font=Courier New] 30 [/font]means in-game 30g.[/list]

[color=#999999][size=1][b]Have I told you yet? This is my first Stardew Valley mod! So, leave your thoughts in the Comment/Posts section. Critics are welcome![/b][/size][/color]
